name: Nakatsu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nakatsu city emblem in black: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a three-armed device with discs.
history: Municipal flag of Nakatsu, a city in Ōita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 May 1930.

features.role: Nakatsu city emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a three-armed device with discs
